data.name: Hosbein
data.gender_notes: Hosbein is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew hoshea, meaning 'salvation' or 'help'. In the Old Testament, Hoshea was a king of Israel who was saved from the Assyrians by the prophet Hosea. In the New Testament, the name Hosanna means 'save us now' and was a cry of praise and supplication. The name Hosbein carries the meaning “Jehovah's salvation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hosbein usually hope their child will grow to embody jehovah's salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hosbein belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jehovah's salvation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hosbein total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
